Excellent Food & Outstanding Service from Linh at Madam Thu
Oct 2026 • Family
We had a wonderful dining experience at Madam Thu Restaurant in Hue. The food was delicious, authentic, and beautifully presented, and the atmosphere was warm and welcoming.
A special thank you to Linh, who provided excellent service throughout our visit. Linh was friendly, attentive, helpful, and made sure everything was taken care of with a genuine smile.
Thank you, Madam Thu and especially Linh, for making our meal such a memorable experience. Highly recommended when visiting Hue! 🇻🇳❤️
